Experience with Kubernetes, CEPH, procurement, supplier management, or ISO 27001/C5 compliance is beneficial.

description:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.
We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.
This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.
The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

What you'll do:
Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

Unser Ansatz: Wir kombinieren alte Bestandsimmobilien mit einer maßgeschneiderten Komplettsanierung zu einem Rundum-Sorglos-Zuhause. So entstehen bezugsfertige, energieeffiziente Eigenheime – individuell geplant, vollständig finanzierbar und ohne Sanierungsstress.
Wir erschaffen Neubau im Altbau getreu unserem Motto: Alt kaufen. Neu wohnen.
Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir ab sofort einen erfahrenen Projekt- & Bauleiter (m/w/d) in Hamburg, der unser Team verstärkt und gemeinsam mit uns Bestandsimmobilien in lebenswerte Wohnräume verwandelt.

Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Bau- und Projektleitung unserer Sanierungsprojekte - von der Vergabe bis zur schlüsselfertigen Übergabe.

Du koordinierst unsere Handwerksbetriebe und Generalunternehmer und stellst die Einhaltung von Terminen, Budgets und Qualitätsstandards sicher.

Du führst Baustellenbegehungen und Baubesprechungen durch, kontrollierst die Ausführung und dokumentierst den Baufortschritt.

Du prüfst und dokumentierst Leistungsstände, Änderungen und Nachträge und bereitest entsprechende Freigaben vor.

Du erkennst Risiken und Verzögerungen frühzeitig, entwickelst Lösungen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Bauablauf.

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Planungsteam, der Kundenbetreuung und den ausführenden Gewerken.

description:
FULL-TIME | 5 DAYS ON-SITE
LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK
FIELD TRAVEL: AS REQUIRED

THE LAST FRONTIER
ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to design, build, and test all electrical systems within ARD’s product stack. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world deployment making an impact at every layer – from the PCB to Arctic field tests. You’ll move fast and take end-to-end ownership of the electronic architecture you’ll build, ensuring seamless operation in the harshest climate on Earth. You will be involved at all stages of electronics development and a key member of the engineering team at our early company stage.

Company
NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with…

Nous recherchons un stagiaire développeur logciel (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême.

Nous développons un logiciel superviseur en C++/Qt permettant le contrôle à distance de différents équipements. Dans le cadre de l'amélioration de notre environnement de développement, nous souhaitons automatiser et accélérer la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
L'objectif du stage sera de concevoir et de développer un outil permettant de générer automatiquement du code à partir d'interfaces graphiques préalablement conçues avec Qt Designer.
Pour cela, le stagiaire sera amené à :
Comprendre l'architecture existante du logiciel superviseur et ses différents composants.

Analyser les besoins et définir une solution adaptée à l'architecture logicielle.

Étudier le format des fichiers d'interface Qt Designer (.ui) afin d'en extraire les informations nécessaires à la génération de code.

Concevoir et développer un outil capable de générer automatiquement :
Les classes associées à la partie graphique du logiciel superviseur.

Les classes d'interface assurant la communication entre la partie graphique et le cœur du logiciel.

Les classes d'implémentation de ces interfaces dans le cœur du logiciel.

description:

Les algorithmes de détection et de suivi basés sur l’apprentissage profond évoluent vite, et leurs performances annoncées se transposent mal à de nouveaux capteurs ou de nouvelles conditions. Notre équipe développe des solutions de vision temps réel et dispose d’une bibliothèque modulaire de pipelines de traitement (C++). 
Il manque une méthode fiable pour comparer les approches et choisir celles à intégrer.

Mettre en place une plateforme d’évaluation reproductible, puis intégrer les solutions les plus pertinentes dans la bibliothèque.

Reprise de l’existant. Analyser le module actuel de détection et de suivi, diagnostiquer ses limites de généralisation sur d’autres capteurs et en rendre compte.

Benchmark de l’état de l’art. Comparer des détecteurs et des trackers récents, avec entraînement ou fine-tuning, augmentation de données et résultats reproductibles. 

Intégration. Intégrer les solutions retenues dans la bibliothèque C++ et réaliser des démonstrations.

Documentation. Rédiger…

Warum wir tun, was wir tun
Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.
Warum es diese Rolle braucht
Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.
Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.
Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.
Was du bewegen wirst
Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
summary: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed…
description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.
We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.
Why this is interesting
Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do
Bring global flood models to the local scale

Bei uns arbeitest Du direkt an echten Kundenumgebungen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als System Engineer arbeitest Du an realen Kundenumgebungen – nicht im Labor.

description:

Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery

Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. description:
Over Ockto
Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.
Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).
Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol
We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

description:
Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems. 
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. title: Customer Support Specialist (Bengaluru, India)
summary: Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a…
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll help customers succeed with the Figma product suite, from individual designers to large enterprise teams. You’ll join an experienced, close-knit support team that cares about each other and about doing great work for customers. AI is changing how people design and build, and our products are changing with it. You’ll be among the first to see how customers use what we ship, you’ll learn directly from our Product and Engineering teams, and what you hear from customers will help shape what we build next.

This is a full-time role based in our Bengaluru office.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
